products.name: XIAO SAMD21
products.editorial_notes_zh: 电池充电不受支持；DAC 为真实模拟输出。
products.notes_en: True 10-bit DAC output. No onboard battery charging.

products.name: XIAO SAMD21 Plus
products.notes_en: Expanded GPIO and onboard battery management.

products.name: XIAO STM32C5

footprint.note: 需按该型号机械图独立确认，不能仅由系列通用外形推断。

products.editorial_notes_zh: 一通道带板载 CAN 收发器；另一通道需外接收发器。GPIO 总数未按电源焊盘计入。
products.notes_en: One CAN FD channel includes an onboard transceiver. The second channel requires an external transceiver.

products.name: XIAO MG24 Sense
products.notes_en: Includes a six-axis IMU and an analog microphone. Wireless features require the matching software stack.

products.name: XIAO RP2350

processor.value: RP2350 / Dual Cortex-M33 or Hazard3 RISC-V

products.editorial_notes_zh: 运行时使用两个处理核心；不得表述为四核心同时运行。
products.notes_en: Select Arm Cortex-M33 or Hazard3 RISC-V. Two processor cores run at a time.

products.name: XIAO RP2040
products.editorial_notes_zh: PIO 是独立硬件状态机；电池充电与 Plus 版分开记录。
products.notes_en: PIO state machines provide programmable hardware timing. Battery charging is not included.

products.name: XIAO RP2040 Plus
products.notes_en: Expanded GPIO and onboard battery management. PIO features are shared with RP2040.

products.name: XIAO RA4M1
products.editorial_notes_zh: CAN 控制器能力与是否集成总线收发器分开表述。
products.notes_en: 14-bit ADC and 12-bit DAC. CAN controller support does not imply an onboard CAN transceiver.

products.name: XIAO ESP32-C3
products.notes_en: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE for compact connected devices.

products.name: XIAO ESP32-C5
products.editorial_notes_zh: 片内 SRAM 采用规格所列 384 KiB；可分配堆容量由固件测量，不能等同该值。
products.notes_en: Supports 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi 6. SRAM capacity is not the same as free application heap.

products.name: XIAO ESP32-C6
products.editorial_notes_zh: 主频字段记录 HP 核；无线协议及 Matter 功能依赖相应软件栈。
products.notes_en: CPU maximum refers to the high-performance core. Thread and Matter require their matching software stacks.

products.name: XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus
products.feature_zh: 大容量应用与图形资源
products.editorial_notes_zh: 片内 SRAM 待与芯片资料确认；不得以 PSRAM 替代 SRAM 字段。
products.notes_en: 16 MB Flash and 8 MB PSRAM. Internal SRAM must be verified separately.

products.name: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
products.editorial_notes_zh: 传感器位于 Sense 扩展板；相机为供货批次相关型号，不固定展示 OV2640 / OV3660 / OV5640 的某一个。外形字段表示核心板占板尺寸。
products.notes_en: Camera and microphone are on the Sense expansion board. Camera model depends on the hardware batch.

products.name: XIAO nRF52840 Sense
products.editorial_notes_zh: 当前版本按最新展示清单使用 Sense 普通版；不得静默替换为 Sense Plus。BLE 数字版本在来源中不一致，界面只显示 Bluetooth LE。
products.notes_en: Six-axis IMU and PDM microphone. Bluetooth LE version details require verification.

products.name: XIAO nRF52840 Plus

exposed_gpio.note: 官方页面 GPIO/PWM 数量存在 18 / 20 口径差异。

products.editorial_notes_zh: 官方页面同时存在 18 与 20 的 GPIO 口径；数量待核实，不显示猜测数值。
products.notes_en: Expanded interfaces. The published GPIO count uses inconsistent definitions and is not verified.

products.name: XIAO nRF54L15 Sense
products.editorial_notes_zh: 内部存储采用 NVM 命名；协处理器与主处理器分开描述。
products.notes_en: Cortex-M33 with a RISC-V coprocessor. Internal nonvolatile storage is listed as NVM.

products.name: XIAO nRF54LM20A Sense
products.editorial_notes_zh: 源文件名称含 nRF54L15LM20A，按现有素材作为 LM20A 图片；需与实物复核。nPM1300 电源管理。
products.notes_en: Includes external Flash and nPM1300 power management. The supplied image filename uses a legacy naming convention.

products.name: XIAO nRF54LM20B Sense
products.feature_zh: 本地 AI 运算加速

footprint.note: 不能由占位图片推断实物机械尺寸。

products.editorial_notes_zh: 暂用 LM20A 图像占位；身份、图片资源键、参数记录均独立。已核实值仅为 SoC 能力；XIAO 板载传感器、存储和引出接口待独立资料核实。
products.notes_en: Reference image: LM20A. Confirmed values describe the LM20B SoC. Board-level memory, sensors and interfaces are not verified.
